description: This file defines the 'ClientOutboundConnectionFactory' class in the Orleans framework. It manages the creation and configuration of outbound client connections, initializing shared components such as message center and connection manager, and providing methods to create connections with specific options.

classes.name: ClientOutboundConnectionFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and configuring outbound client connections in Orleans, ensuring proper initialization and leveraging dependency injection.

methods.name: ClientOutboundConnectionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with necessary options, shared connection, and helper instances.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates a new outbound client connection to the specified address with the given context.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures the connection builder with client-specific options.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that the message center and connection manager are initialized in a thread-safe manner.
